known_issues.F5: Insight #2 always says 'Fade is accelerating' regardless of the computed slopes.

insights: Capacity fell from 99.9% to 86.1% SOH over 320 cycles; recent fade is 0.054 %/cycle.
Fade is accelerating: first-half 0.036 vs last-120 0.054 %/cycle.
1 temperature and 2 voltage events were flagged. With so few events there is insufficient evidence to link them to degradation (correlation ≠ causation).
The straight-line forecast has a hold-out MAE of 0.58 SOH points; treat the RUL as an estimate.

overview_hero.appended_text: Fade has accelerated over the cell’s life, so the true remaining life may be shorter than a linear fit implies.
